scope: Only instrumentProgressSeparation gains actual caption geometry/visibility and positioned sibling paint-order assertions. Existing separation gate remains intact. No source mutation by reviewer.
whyValid: Redline and speed are actual positioned sibling contexts with explicit integer z-index. Their relative paint order is governed by those z-indices. Requiring redline greater than speed on bounding overlap rejects V19 equal2/equal2 and accepts corrected2/1. DOM ancestry and positions are checked; nonnumeric auto is rejected. Caption text range/visibility/overflow and viewport gates remain required even without overlap.
limits: The overlap is deliberately conservative for the whole speed-ring bounds rather than the exact SVG fill silhouette.
The guard covers this sibling-context occlusion, not arbitrary unrelated overlays or rendered contrast.
CPU cases validate the actual assertions, not native DOM layout or painting. Next native gate and frame are still required.
